Game Overview

In Merge Battle Tactics, the core idea is straightforward: summon and merge creatures in a captivating fantasy realm where strategy is your ally. Engage in thrilling battles by combining monsters to create powerful warriors, balance your forces on the battlefield, and earn coins to expand your ranks. Will your tactical prowess lead you to victory?
